text:
sam: Quick check — I'm about to merge a module refactor that changes provider source from registry.terraform.io/hashicorp/aws to our mirror at internal.registry.aws. Plan in CI shows provider mismatch errors. Anyone seen state needing provider replacement? Example provider block I'm changing:
```hcl
provider "aws" {
  region = var.region
}
module "storage" {
  source = "git::ssh://git@.../modules/storage.git//aws"
}
```
I plan to push a patch to rewrite module sources to use our mirror and add provider_installation in .terraformrc. Thoughts?

jessica: Can you paste the exact plan error? Also do we have lockfile updates? If lockfile changes, will it break older agents?

sam: CI plan snippet:
```text
Error: Incompatible provider registry
  on .../modules/storage/main.tf line 3, in provider "aws":
  provider registry: "registry.terraform.io/hashicorp/aws" required, but found "internal.registry.aws"
```

kai: This is usually resolved by (1) updating provider_lock.json via `terraform providers lock` after init, or (2) running `terraform state replace-provider 'registry.terraform.io/hashicorp/aws' 'internal.registry/aws'` to update state. If you plan to change module source, we should do state replace in staging first. Also add a provider_installation block to CLI config to map the mirror. Example:
```hcl
provider_installation {
  network_mirror {
    url = "https://internal.registry.aws/"
  }
  direct {}
}
```

jessica: I'll run a quick canary in staging tonight. Sam, please don't merge until I confirm. @infra-bot can you run workspace 'staging' plan with env var TF_CLI_CONFIG_FILE set?

infra-bot: enqueued plan run for workspace staging — build #4523. Link: https://ci.internal/plan/4523 :hourglass:

sam: :thumbsup: I'll hold off. One question — will we need to bump module versions in root repo or can we keep semver and only update sources? I prefer minimal churn.

kai: If mirror keeps same module content and versions, no need to bump. But if you change module path (e.g., move to namespaced mirror) that can affect module source address. Better to tag a minor version and update root reference.

jessica: Result: staging plan succeeded, lockfile updated. infra-bot shows plan ok. You can merge after I push a follow-up that runs `terraform state replace-provider` in staging before prod migration. :green_heart:

sam: Thanks — will wait for the follow-up PR. I'll also add note in the changelog about lockfile/regeneration. :eyes:
